name: Bloodhoof Village
summary: Young tauren gather at Bloodhoof Village beside Stonebull Lake in central Mulgore. Led by Baine Bloodhoof, the village guides them from Camp Narache toward Thunder Bluff and tends the plains’ defense, trade, and rites.

sections.title: Heart of the Plains
sections.body: Bloodhoof Village gathers tauren around Stonebull Lake in central Mulgore. Young tauren arrive from their trials at Camp Narache to hone their skills before traveling onward to the great mesas of Thunder Bluff. Patient breeders here tame wild kodo beasts for travel, while the village is also a center of craft and ceremony.

sections.title: Leadership and Rites
sections.body: Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, oversees daily governance and the region’s defense. Braves patrol the grasslands against aggressive wildlife, quilboar encroachers, and the Venture Company. Spiritual guides such as Zarlman Two-Moons tend to the tribe’s inner life and lead novices through sacred journeys like the Rite of Vision.

aliases: who is in charge of bloodhoof village
faq.answer: Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, leads Bloodhoof Village and directs its defenses against threats to the central plains.

faq.q: What major rites are conducted here?
faq.answer: Spiritual guides such as Zarlman Two-Moons lead young tauren through the traditional Rite of Vision, an essential spiritual journey on the path to adulthood.

faq.q: What is the settlement known for producing?
faq.answer: Bloodhoof Village is the main place where wild plains kodos are tamed and trained as mounts.

faq.q: Where do travelers go after finishing their tasks here?
faq.answer: After their deeds in central Mulgore, travelers are generally directed north to Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

angles.text: For young tauren, entering Bloodhoof Village marks their first real step beyond youth and into broader tribal responsibility and spiritual maturity.
For the Horde, Bloodhoof Village is a peaceful stopover and a vital link between Mulgore’s southern plains and the Horde capital at Thunder Bluff.
